name: geostatistics-interpolation
description: Turn scattered point measurements into continuous surfaces with quantified uncertainty: variogram modeling, ordinary/universal/regression kriging, IDW, and spatially honest cross-validation. Use when unobserved values must be estimated from sparse samples such as stations, wells, or soundings. Trigger on "interpolate", "kriging", "variogram", or "IDW"; a named interpolation method is sufficient even when the requested surface is described informally as a heatmap. Do not use for point-density heatmaps, zonal aggregation, or raster resampling without value interpolation.
